node.statement: Norm finish: under K >= 1, 0 <= eta <= 1, epsilon <= 4*K*eta, K*eta <= K*sqrt(eta), ||Q-AM||_{infinity->infinity} <= K*eta, and ||AM-E||_{infinity->infinity} <= 2*sqrt(2*epsilon), the triangle inequality and monotonicity of square roots imply ||Q-E||_{infinity->infinity} <= (K+4*sqrt(2*K))*sqrt(eta).
